step.names.intro: Write the names the way you want them on the website, and choose the language.
step.date.name: Date and address

step.template.name: Template and colours
step.template.title: Choose how your website looks
step.template.intro: You can change the template and colours at any time, even after publishing. The preview shows how it looks (on a phone, tap Preview).
step.program.name: Programme and venue
step.program.title: The day’s programme and venue
step.program.intro: Optional. Skip anything you don’t know yet and add it later.
step.info.name: Practical information
step.info.title: What guests should know
step.info.intro: Optional. Dress code, accommodation, transport and contact.
step.rsvp.name: RSVP
step.rsvp.title: How will guests confirm they are coming?
step.rsvp.intro: Optional. When guests need to reply by, and what you’ll ask them.
step.access.name: Access and privacy

step.access.intro: Optional. How the website is protected and whether you want a guest PIN.
step.review.name: Review

names.first.label: Your name
names.second.label: Your partner’s name
locales.hint: The website can be in Czech, in English, or in both. Choose at least one.
locales.default.hint: Any text you don’t translate is shown in this language. You can change the languages later in your dashboard.
date.label: Wedding date
date.first.label: First day of the wedding
date.hint: The website counts down to this day and shows the programme on the day. The day after the wedding, it switches to a thank-you page on its own.
date.multiDay: The wedding lasts more than one day
date.last.label: Last day of the wedding
date.last.hint: The day after this one, the website switches to a thank-you page on its own.
slug.label: Website address
slug.hint: Guests type this into their browser. We suggested it from your names. Use only lowercase letters without accents, numbers and hyphens.
slug.unavailable: This address can’t be used. Try changing it, for example by adding a surname or the place of your wedding.
slug.limited: We can’t check the address right now. Carry on, and we’ll check it when you save.
slug.error: We could not check availability right now. We will check it when you save.
slug.problem.too_short: The address must have at least 3 characters.
slug.problem.too_long: The address can have at most 63 characters.
slug.problem.format: Use only lowercase letters without accents, numbers and hyphens. A hyphen cannot be at the start or the end, and two in a row are not allowed.
slug.reservationNote: The address becomes yours when you first save your draft. We then hold it for 30 days after your last change. You can change it until you publish, but not after.
slug.yearWarning: Careful: the address contains a year. Anyone who sees it on a printed invitation can tell the year of the wedding. Keep it if you do not mind; otherwise choose another one.
slug.conflict.legend: This address is already taken. Choose a variant.
slug.conflict.body: Everything you entered is still here, nothing was lost. Here are some available variants:
slug.variant.year: contains the year of the wedding
slug.variant.month: contains the year and month of the wedding
slug.variant.random: an unguessable variant with random characters
slug.extra.label: Or add the place or date of your wedding to the address
slug.extra.hint: For example, the town or village where you’re getting married. We’ll add it after {base}.
template.hint: The template sets the layout and fonts. Your content stays the same whichever one you choose.
template.editorial.description: Clean and elegant, with the focus on text.

template.modern.description: Bold colour and a strong typeface.
palette.contrastNote: All the colour options are easy to read.

venue.directions.label: How to get there (optional)

map.not_found: We could not find this address on the map. Try adding the street, house number and town.
map.limited: Map search is busy right now. We will try again when you edit the address.
map.error: The address could not be looked up. The website will be published without a map.
extra.hint: More items in the programme, for example a toast, the first dance or a buffet. All of them are on the wedding day.
extra.title: Title

dressCode.label: Dress code

contacts.hint: Who guests can call or write to. You can add up to 3 contacts.

contacts.max: You can add at most {max} contacts.
rsvp.deadline.label: Confirm attendance by (optional)
rsvp.deadline.hint: After this day guests can no longer confirm. Without a date, confirming stays open until the wedding.
rsvp.questions.hint: We always ask for the name and whether they are coming.
rsvp.plusOne: A guest can bring a plus one
rsvp.dietHint: This is health information. We store it separately and delete it ourselves after the wedding.
rsvp.emailConfirmation: Send guests a confirmation by email
rsvp.emailConfirmationHint: The guest enters an email only for this message; we use it for nothing else.
rsvp.later: The RSVP form will be on your website, but only guests on your guest list can reply. Add them in your dashboard under Guests. You can change these settings, and allow replies from guests who aren’t on the list, under Replies → Reply settings.
access.noindex.title: The website does not appear in search engines
access.noindex.body: Only people you send the link or the QR code to will find your website. Search engines do not list it, and we never pass the link on by ourselves.
access.noindex.note: This applies to every website on se-vezmou.cz and cannot be turned off.
access.pin.title: Guest PIN
access.pin.body: It’s a number you print on your invitations. Guests who enter it can also see private details, such as your bank account for gifts (you add that in your dashboard). Without a guest PIN, those details don’t appear at all. Guests see the rest of the website without it.
access.pin.enable: Protect the sensitive parts of the website with a PIN
access.pin.enableHint: After publishing, we’ll show you the PIN one last time. If you forget it, you can set a new one in your dashboard.
access.pin.label: Guest PIN
access.pin.hint: {min} to {max} digits. Avoid sequences like 123456 or repeats like 111111.
access.pin.storage: For security, we don’t store your PIN in a readable form, so you’ll see it only once after publishing.
review.ok: Everything needed is filled in. The website can be published.
review.gaps.title: Some texts have no translation

finish.accountNote: When you save for the first time, we will ask for your email and send you a code. You do not need a password.
finish.save.title: Save as a draft
finish.save.body: A draft is private. You can keep working on it and publish it whenever you like.
finish.save.point.private: Nobody sees it, and search engines will not find it.
finish.save.point.preview: You get a preview link nobody can guess. You can send it to anyone who should see the draft.
finish.save.point.reservation: Your address stays reserved for 30 days from your last edit.
finish.save.blocked: You can save once steps 1 to 3 are complete.
finish.publish.title: Publish the website
finish.publish.point.permanent: Once published, the address can’t be changed, and no other couple will ever get it.
finish.publish.point.indexing: The website still does not appear in search engines. You give the link only to the people you choose.
finish.publish.point.edit: You can keep editing the text and the look. Guests see your changes once you tap Publish changes.

save.email.label: Your email
save.email.hint: We will send a code to it, and you will sign in with it later.
save.backup.label: Backup email
save.backup.hint: For example, your partner’s email. It helps if you can’t get into the first one. It must be different from the first.
save.error.email: Enter a valid email, for example klara@example.com.
save.error.backup: Enter a valid backup email, for example matej@example.com.
save.error.same: The backup email must be different from your main email.
save.error.limited: There have been too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again. Nothing has been lost.
save.error.bot: We couldn’t confirm that a person is filling in the form. Reload the page and try again. If you use an ad blocker, turn it off for this page.

save.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

previewLink.hint: A private link nobody can guess. Send it only to people who should see the draft.
previewLink.warning: You can see this link only now, so copy it straight away. If you lose it, create a new one. The old one will stop working.
preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: This is how guests will see the website. It changes as soon as you edit something.
preview.banner: Preview of a private draft. Guests cannot see it.
done.title: Done, your website is live!
done.intro: Your website is published. You can send the address to guests or print it on your invitations.
done.qr.title: QR code
done.qr.body: Guests scan it with their phone and your website opens. It’s handy on your invitations.
done.qrLabel: QR code with the website address {address}
done.pin.title: Guest PIN
done.pin.body: This is the last time you’ll see this PIN. Copy it now or download the printable card. If you forget it, you can set a new one in your dashboard under Access.
done.share.title: Send to guests
done.share.body: Send the website address to your guests. We do not add the PIN to the message, it belongs with the invitation.
done.share.subject: Our wedding website
done.share.message: We would love you to join our wedding. You will find all the details on our website: {url}
done.pdf.title: Card to print
done.pdf.body: An A4 page with the website address, the QR code and the PIN, which you can print or enclose with the invitation.
done.pdf.note: The PDF is meant for printing. You will find the same details on this page.

explain.address.title: What’s the website address?
explain.address.body:
It’s what your guests type into their browser or open from the QR code on your invitation, for example klara-and-matej.se-vezmou.cz. You only choose the first part; the .se-vezmou.cz ending is the same for every website.

You can change it as often as you like until you publish. After that it stays the same, so it keeps working on printed invitations.
explain.draft.title: What’s a draft, and what does publishing do?
explain.draft.body:
A draft is your website while you work on it. Only you can see it, plus anyone you send the private preview link to.

Publishing opens it to your guests at its address. You can still change the text, look and languages afterwards, and you can hide it again from your dashboard. Only the address stays the same.
explain.preview.title: Who can see the preview?
explain.preview.body:
Only you; guests can’t. It updates as soon as you change something. It’s just a picture of your website, so you can’t click around in it.

Once you save your draft, you also get a private preview link you can send to someone, for example your best man or maid of honour.
explain.pin.title: What’s the guest PIN for?
explain.pin.body:
The PIN works like a numeric password, a bit like the one for a bank card. You print it on your invitations, and guests use it to unlock private details on your website, such as your bank account for gifts.

Anyone without the PIN sees only the public parts: the programme, the venue and other information. You can change the PIN at any time in your dashboard.
explain.rsvp.title: How will guests RSVP?
explain.rsvp.body:
Your website will have a form where guests say whether they’re coming. Guests on your guest list can reply; you add them in your dashboard under Guests. Under Replies → Reply settings, you can also allow replies from guests who aren’t on the list.

You’ll see their answers under Replies, and you can download them as a spreadsheet under Guests.
explain.email.title: Why do you need my email?
explain.email.body:
Your email replaces a password: each time you sign in, we send you a code, so there’s nothing to remember.

A backup email, for example your partner’s, is a safety net in case you can’t get into the first one.
explain.map.title: Where does the map come from?
explain.map.body: It comes from OpenStreetMap and loads through our website, so your guests’ browsers don’t send anything to anyone else. Guests also get links to open the place in Google Maps or Mapy.cz.
explain.skip.title: Not sure yet?
explain.skip.body: This step is optional. Tap Skip to leave it out and add it later, even after publishing, in your dashboard. Anything you’ve already filled in stays saved.
